subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5798fb39ba996eae9bb6b83f3db196e8bdbb23aed2fc642f511809ea5d11cb69.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Centre figure is rotated 90º anticlockwise direction in every next figure.

2) In 1st and 2nd figure, One curve is rotated 180° anticlockwise direction. 

3) In 2nd and 3rd figure, two curve is rotated 180°
